ui.aboutBody: PEMF Vet launcher. It downloads your selected usage profiles, verifies the downloaded files, installs them and opens the app. It connects automatically to the PEMF device on your network.
ui.authSlow: Slow connection — verifying your session in the background. You can start the app now.
ui.backupSameDisk: Backups are currently on the SAME disk as patient data. A disk failure would lose both; choose an external drive or a network share.
ui.backupUnreachable: Backup destination is currently unreachable: {{yol}} — plug in the external drive or choose a new destination.
ui.bgCancelConfirm:
Cancel the download?

The part downloaded so far will be DELETED and the update will start OVER on the next launch.

If you only want a break, use "Pause" — the downloaded part is kept and resumes where it left off.
ui.coreDesc: Interface and shared models — required by every profile
ui.coreLocked: The main application is part of every installation; it cannot be unselected.
ui.depNotice: “{{secili}}” is selected without “{{eksik}}”. They install independently; only AI Pro’s organ localization uses models from the {{eksik}} package — that feature will not work. Everything else works.
ui.errDisk: Not enough disk space. Free up space and try again.
ui.errDns: Could not reach the internet — the server address could not be resolved. Check your Wi-Fi/network and try again. If you are online, retry in a few minutes.
ui.errSunucu: The update server is unreachable right now. This is not about your connection; try again shortly.
ui.errTimeout: The connection timed out. Your network may be slow or briefly interrupted; please try again.
ui.fwEngel: Windows Firewall is BLOCKING incoming connections to this app — the mobile app cannot find the device. Use from the device screen is not affected.
ui.fwKuralYok: The mobile app may not be able to connect to this device: Windows Firewall has no rule allowing incoming connections. Use from the device screen is not affected.
ui.guncLead: Please wait — the new version is being installed. PEMF Vet will reopen by itself; you don't need to close this window or start the app again.
ui.guncSlow: Taking a bit longer — installation can take 1–2 minutes depending on your computer. If this window doesn't close on its own, open PEMF Vet from the Start menu.

kilavuz.connect: In veterinary mode the PEMF hardware must be on the SAME Wi-Fi network as your computer. The app finds it automatically; if not, enter the device IP manually in the app's Settings.
kilavuz.intro: PEMF Vet is a platform for AI-assisted diagnosis and PEMF (pulsed magnetic field) sessions in cats. This client downloads, installs and starts the app on your computer. The steps below are written for someone with no prior experience — just follow them in order.
kilavuz.profTitle: 3 Profiles — which one is for you?

p01.does: Runs AI pre-diagnosis from your cat's camera image: disease, organ, imaging and sound analysis. Does NOT include a device or session.

use.u01: When the app opens, choose ‘Pet Owner’ and sign in.
use.u03: Point your camera at the cat or upload a photo/sound file.
use.u04: Read the result and suggestions — always consult a veterinarian for a definitive diagnosis.

p02.does: Diagnosis + PEMF device sessions + patient records, session history, sensor tracking, KPI panel and simulator. Also includes the Pet Owner diagnostic models (hence the larger size).

use.u03: Start a session from ‘Control’; adjust coils manually or run autonomously with ‘AI Pro’.
use.u04: Track the session via ‘Sensors’ and ‘History’; see clinic stats in ‘KPI’.

p03.does: Petri, histopathology, kidney and phantom AI models; sample/data records and history. Does NOT include a device.

use.u02: Pick the relevant research model from ‘Smart Diagnosis’.
use.u03: Upload your image or data file.
use.u04: Review the results and save them to ‘History’.

s01.b: The 'Main application' card at the top is part of every installation and cannot be removed (interface and shared models; its size is shown on the right, or 'installed' if already present). Tick at least one of the 3 profiles below it (Pet Owner, Veterinarian, Research). You can pick several; each card shows ONLY its own download size, and the button total counts only what will actually download (the main application if not yet installed + your new picks). In 'Change profiles', an already installed profile says 'installed' and is not counted; unticking an installed profile marks it 'will be removed' and it is deleted from this computer when you press the button.

s02.b: Your selected models download and install. The bar shows percent, speed (MB/s) and time left. You can Pause or Cancel anytime; even if the internet drops or the computer shuts down, you can resume where you left off when you reopen.

s03.b: When installation finishes, the app opens in your browser. Next time, use the ‘Start’ button in this window to open it in seconds.

k01.b: Click ‘Repair’ in this window — it re-verifies the packages and fills in what's missing.
k01.t: The app won't open or a model is missing

k02.b: Reopen the app; answer ‘Resume where you left off?’ with ‘Resume’. The downloaded part is kept.

k03.b: Click ‘Uninstall’ (your patient data is KEPT), then install again.
k03.t: I want to reinstall from scratch

k04.b: Use the ‘Website’ link at the top or ‘Support’ at the bottom.

ui.readyLead: PEMF Vet is installed. Start the app or update your profiles.
ui.repairBody: Installed packages will be re-verified and missing/corrupt files repaired. This may take a few minutes. Continue?
ui.resumeBody: The previous installation didn't complete (internet may have dropped or the device was closed). The downloaded part is kept — resume where you left off?
ui.rtBg: A new version is downloading in the background — you can use the app now; it will be installed on the next launch.
ui.rtBgCancelled: Update download cancelled — it will be retried on the next launch.
ui.rtBgDone: New version downloaded — it will be installed on the next launch.
ui.rtBgFail: Background download did not finish — it will resume on the next launch.
ui.rtBgPaused: Update download paused — the downloaded part is kept; "Resume" continues where it left off.
ui.rtBlocked: The new version failed to start on this device, so the previous one was restored. Automatic retries are paused — use "Repair" to try again, or wait for the next release.
ui.rtBusy: Updates are not applied during a session — it will update automatically once the session ends.
ui.rtLead: A new app version was found — downloading and installing. You can start it when this finishes.
ui.rtReady: Update ready — it will be installed when you close and reopen the app.
ui.rtRecall: ⚠️ IMPORTANT SAFETY UPDATE pending. This version is no longer supported; please CLOSE AND REOPEN the app so the update installs. If a session is running, wait for it to finish.
ui.rtRollback: The new version failed to start; rolled back to the previous working version. The app is usable.
ui.rtRollbackFail: The new version failed to start and the rollback could not finish. Please use "Repair" to reinstall.
ui.runningLead: PEMF Vet is running. If you close the app window you can start it again from here.
ui.selLead: The main application is always installed (cannot be removed). Pick at least one profile — only the ones you pick are downloaded.
ui.selfUpdateFailed: Launcher update could not be completed — the app is opening normally. It will be retried on the next launch.
